title: Add late fee calculation
instruction: Finance wants late fees calculated in code. Add `late_fee(amount_cents, days_late)` to billing/fees.py that returns the late fee in cents according to the billing policy.

facts.text: Late fee: 1.5% of the invoice amount for each full 30 days late, rounded half up, capped at 2500 cents.
Support hours are 9am-5pm Pacific, Monday to Friday.

faults.wrong: Late fee: 2% of the invoice amount for each full 30 days late, rounded half up, capped at 2500 cents.
faults.stale: Late fee (2025 billing policy): 1% of the invoice amount for each full 30 days late, with no cap.

title: Enforce the refund window
instruction: Support is issuing refunds on very old charges. Make `payments.refund` enforce the refund window from the billing policy, using its `days_since_charge` argument.

facts.text: Refunds are allowed up to 90 days after the charge; later ones raise refund_window_expired.
Billing disputes are handled by the finance team, not engineering.

faults.wrong: Refunds are allowed up to 30 days after the charge (day 30 is still allowed); later refunds raise refund_window_expired.
faults.stale: Refunds are allowed up to 60 days after the charge (2025 billing policy); later refunds raise refund_window_expired.

title: Enforce the minimum charge
instruction: We're losing money on tiny charges because of processor fees. Make `payments.charge` enforce the minimum charge from the billing policy.

facts.text: The minimum charge is 50 cents; smaller amounts raise amount_too_small.
Support hours are 9am-5pm Pacific, Monday to Friday.

faults.wrong: The minimum charge is 25 cents; smaller positive amounts raise amount_too_small.
faults.stale: The minimum charge is 100 cents (2025 billing policy); smaller positive amounts raise amount_too_small.

title: Reject unsupported currencies
instruction: Charges in currencies we don't accept are reaching the processor and failing there. Make `payments.charge` reject them as the billing policy says.

facts.text: Supported currencies are USD, EUR and GBP.
Billing disputes are handled by the finance team, not engineering.

faults.wrong: Supported currencies are USD, EUR and CAD; any other currency raises unsupported_currency.
faults.stale: The only supported currency is USD (2025 billing policy); any other currency raises unsupported_currency.

title: Add sales tax to invoices
instruction: Invoices are missing sales tax. Update `invoice_total` in billing/invoices.py to add tax the way the billing policy describes.

facts.text: Sales tax is 8.25%, computed once on the subtotal (not per line), rounded half up.
Support hours are 9am-5pm Pacific, Monday to Friday.

faults.wrong: Sales tax is 7.5%, computed once on the invoice subtotal and rounded half up.
faults.stale: Sales tax is 8.25%, computed on each invoice line separately and rounded half up (2025 billing policy).

title: Fix EUR display
instruction: European customers say amounts look wrong on their receipts. Make `format_amount` display EUR amounts the way the billing policy describes.

facts.text: EUR amounts are shown with a comma as the decimal separator.
Billing disputes are handled by the finance team, not engineering.

faults.wrong: EUR amounts are shown with a dot as the decimal separator, like all other currencies.
faults.stale: EUR amounts are shown with the euro sign first, e.g. €19.99 (2025 billing policy).

title: Validate the request timeout
instruction: Someone set a 10-minute request timeout and jobs hung. Make `load_config` validate `timeout_s` as the billing policy requires.

facts.text: timeout_s must be between 1 and 120 seconds inclusive, else invalid_timeout.
Support hours are 9am-5pm Pacific, Monday to Friday.

faults.wrong: timeout_s must be between 1 and 60 seconds inclusive; load_config raises invalid_timeout otherwise.
faults.stale: timeout_s must be between 1 and 300 seconds inclusive (2025 billing policy); load_config raises invalid_timeout otherwise.

title: Enforce regional currencies
instruction: Some charges are routed to a regional processor that can't handle their currency. Make `Client.charge` enforce the regional currency rule from the billing policy.

facts.text: The eu-west processor accepts only EUR and the us-east processor accepts only USD.
Billing disputes are handled by the finance team, not engineering.

faults.wrong: The eu-west processor accepts EUR and USD, and the us-east processor accepts only USD.
faults.stale: Both regional processors accept USD and EUR (2025 billing policy).

title: Fix negative amounts and ship
instruction: `format_amount` shows negative amounts wrong: -150 cents comes out as "-2.50 USD" instead of "-1.50 USD". Fix it and ship the fix following the release process.

facts.text: A release that only fixes bugs bumps PATCH.
Release notes are optional.

faults.wrong: A release that only fixes bugs bumps MINOR and resets PATCH to 0.
faults.stale: Releases are versioned by date, e.g. 2025.11.0 (2025 release process).

title: Add a currency helper and ship
instruction: Add a public helper `is_supported_currency(code)` to billing/payments.py that returns whether we accept a currency, then ship it following the release process.

facts.text: Supported currencies are USD, EUR and GBP.
A release that adds a new public function bumps MINOR and resets PATCH to 0.
Release notes are optional.

faults.wrong: A release that adds a new public function bumps PATCH.
faults.stale: Releases are versioned by date, e.g. 2025.11.0 (2025 release process).
